claims.text: GDACS assessed an Orange alert for a forest fire in Greece covering the period 31 July-4 August 2026, citing approximately 18,299 hectares burned and about 1,648 people in the fire-affected area, noting the fire "can have a medium humanitarian impact based on the burned area and the affected population and their vulnerability."

description: A wildfire broke out on 31 July 2026 near Psatha and Porto Germeno in western Attica, west of Athens, amid a European heatwave, spreading rapidly under strong winds and prompting evacuations and sea rescues along the coast. GDACS assessed an Orange alert for medium humanitarian impact, citing about 18,299 hectares burned and roughly 1,648 people in the fire-affected area as of 4 August 2026. No allowlisted authoritative source has published a confirmed death toll for this fire; international media reported firefighters and helicopter crew killed during the response, but this remains unconfirmed by an allowlisted source.

impact.summary: GDACS's event report (eventid 1029987, GLIDE WF-2026-000142-GRC, episode 15) assessed an Orange alert for medium humanitarian impact for a forest fire burning in western Attica, Greece, covering a 31 July-4 August 2026 window, citing about 18,299 hectares burned and roughly 1,648 people in the fire-affected area. No allowlisted authoritative source has published a confirmed death toll or evacuation count, and no source has declared the fire contained.

location.region: Western Attica (Psatha, Porto Germeno), west of Athens

name: Wildfire — Western Attica, Greece
